title: Registration Now Open for THRIVELIVE 2027
html:
Join The Premier Dental Growth Event at Resorts World Las Vegas this Spring

Registration is now open for THRIVELIVE® 2027, co-hosted by Henry Schein, Inc. and Henry Schein One. Returning to Resorts World Las Vegas from April 28 to May 1, 2027, the annual event will bring together dental professionals and their teams for three days of education, networking, and entertainment. Attendees can choose from more than 100 courses, earn up to 15 CE credits, hear from leading voices in dentistry, and explore the latest practice technologies and solutions, including Ascend by Dentrix.

New for 2027, THRIVELIVE is expanding its educational programming and industry collaborations through partnerships with the American Association of Dental Office Management (AADOM), BioHorizons, Dykema, Spear, and 3Shape. These collaborations will broaden course offerings and provide relevant educational content for a wider range of dental professionals and practice team members. The event will also introduce suggested customer paths designed to help attendees tailor their experiences to specific practice goals. From growing revenue and increasing efficiency to expanding a practice and leading a team, dental professionals can easily identify sessions and experiences aligned with their priorities.

Beyond education and networking, THRIVELIVE will feature evening entertainment. Past events have featured headliners, including comedian Howie Mandel and legendary skateboarder Tony Hawk. The 2027 event promises to be just as exciting, with even more world-class speakers and performances planned.

Ultra Early Bird registration is open through December 31, 2026, offering early course enrollment and discounted rates before prices increase.

For more information about THRIVELIVE, visit thrivelive2027.com.

Stay tuned for the full speaker lineup and headlining entertainer.
